name: 森林生态系统
era: 全球各气候带（热带至寒带）
oneLiner: 以乔木为骨架的多层生命系统，是陆地生物多样性与碳储的中心。
oneLinerEn: A multi-layered living system built on trees — the center of terrestrial biodiversity and carbon storage.

positions.v: 林冠、林下、灌木、地被分层。
positions.vEn: Canopy, understory, shrub and floor layers.

positions.v: 固碳、涵养水源、庇护物种。
positions.vEn: Sequesters carbon, holds water, shelters species.

why: 地球上约一半陆地物种栖于森林；其碳库与气候、水安全直接相连。
whyEn: About half of land species live in forests; their carbon pools tie directly to climate and water security.

name: 草原生态系统
oneLiner: 以草本为主、乔木稀少的开阔系统，是放牧与大型草食动物的舞台。
oneLinerEn: Open herb-dominated systems with few trees — the stage for grazing and large herbivores.

positions.v: 降水不足以育林，旱季明显。
positions.vEn: Too dry for forest, marked dry seasons.

positions.v: 周期性干扰维持草优势。

why: 全球重要的粮食与畜牧带，也是碳储存与野生物种的关键栖息地。
whyEn: A major grain and livestock belt, and key habitat for carbon storage and wildlife.

name: 珊瑚礁生态系统
oneLiner: 由珊瑚虫与虫黄藻共生筑成的「海中雨林」，单位面积生物多样性极高。
oneLinerEn: Built by corals and their algae symbionts — a 'rainforest of the sea' with extreme local biodiversity.

positions.v: 珊瑚虫与虫黄藻互利供能。
升温即白化，对污染敏感。
positions.vEn: Bleaches when warm; sensitive to pollution.

why: 庇护约四分之一海洋物种，护岸与支撑渔业旅游；升温正引发大面积白化。
whyEn: Shelters ~25% of marine species and protects coasts; warming drives mass bleaching.

name: 湿地生态系统
oneLiner: 水陆交错的过渡带，净化水质、调蓄洪水、固碳能力居各生态系统之首。
oneLinerEn: Water-land transition zones that clean water, buffer floods and top all ecosystems in carbon storage.

positions.v: 过滤污染物、蓄洪、育幼场。

why: 单位面积固碳最高，却在过去百年被填垦消失最快，保护优先级极高。
whyEn: Highest carbon density per area, yet the fastest-disappearing — top protection priority.

name: 海洋生态系统
oneLiner: 覆盖七成地表、调节气候与氧碳循环的最大生命系统；从浮游生物到巨鲸。
oneLinerEn: Covering 70% of Earth and regulating climate and the O₂/CO₂ cycle — from plankton to whales.

positions.v: 浮游植物贡献半数光合产氧。

why: 地球气候与食物链的根基；塑料、升温与酸化是其三大威胁。
whyEn: Foundation of climate and food webs; plastics, warming and acidification are the three threats.

name: 淡水生态系统
oneLiner: 仅占地表淡水不足 1% 的液态水，却承载不成比例的物种与人类用水。
oneLinerEn: Less than 1% of liquid surface freshwater, yet hosts a disproportionate share of species and human water use.
why: 饮用水与灌溉之源，生物多样性热点，却因截流与污染退化最快。
whyEn: Source of drinking and irrigation water and a biodiversity hotspot, yet degrading fastest via damming and pollution.

name: 苔原与极地生态
oneLiner: 低温、生长季短、冻土广布；地衣苔藓与候鸟、大型草食者共存的脆弱系统。
oneLinerEn: Cold, short seasons and widespread permafrost; a fragile system of lichens, mosses, migratory birds and large grazers.
why: 冻土碳库影响全球气候； thawing 释放温室气体形成正反馈。
whyEn: Its frozen carbon shapes global climate; thawing releases greenhouse gases in a feedback loop.

name: 稀树草原
era: 热带雨林两侧（非洲为主）
oneLiner: 草为主、疏树点缀，干湿季分明，支撑着大规模野生动物迁徙。
oneLinerEn: Grass-dominated with scattered trees and distinct wet/dry seasons, supporting vast wildlife migrations.
why: 全球重要牧业与碳储存区，也是人象等共演化的舞台。
whyEn: A global pasture and carbon zone, and the stage of human–elephant coevolution.
